$$
x={cos}^{3}⁡t,\,y={sin}^{3}⁡t,\,t\in [0,\frac{\pi }{2}].
$$

What integral gives the surface area generated when this curve is rotated $2\pi $ radians about the $x$-axis?

Question 4

Consider the curve defined parametrically as x=cos3⁡t,y=sin3⁡t,t∈[0,π2]. What integral gives the surface area generated when this curve is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis?

a
 6π∫0π/2sin4⁡tcos⁡tdt
b
 6π∫0π/2sin3⁡tdt
c
 3π∫0π/2cos3⁡tdt
d
 2π∫0π/2cos4⁡tsin⁡tdt
e
 2π∫0π/2sin4⁡tcos4⁡tdt
